case_title.reason: Matches the judgment's caption: Manoj and Anr. v. State of Karnataka.

number_of_accused.reason: Two appellants/accused, father and son, are stated throughout.

accused_gender.reason: Accused referred to as 'his son' and 'his father', indicating male accused.

accused_age.reason: No age of the accused is stated in the judgment.

accused_religion.reason: No religious identity of the accused is described.

accused_caste.reason: No caste or community of the accused is named.

accused_occupation.reason: No occupation of the accused is stated.

accused_socioeconomic_status.reason: No statement on the accused's wealth or class appears.

previous_criminal_record.reason: Judgment is silent on any prior criminal record.

victim_gender.reason: Victim is Sadashiv, referred to as the deceased's brother and husband; male.

victim_caste.reason: No caste of the victim is named.

victim_religion.reason: No religious identity of the victim is described.

accused_victim_relationship.reason: Suspicion of illicit intimacy, prior prohibition and threat are described; fits prior dispute category.

offence_category.reason: Charged under s.302 IPC, i.e. murder.

statutory_provisions.reason: Matches charged sections (302/506 r/w 34) and s.325 substitution.

weapon.reason: Sword (M.O.1) and stone (M.O.2) are both identified as weapons.

evidence_type.correct_value: Eyewitness (PWs 8 and 18); testimony of PW-16 on motive and prior threats; medical (post-mortem); forensic (FSL report on blood on sword and stone); recovery/seizure (site plan and seizures by police)
evidence_type.quote: the presence of the two eye witnesses on the spot at the time of occurrence
evidence_type.reason: Only PWs 8 and 18 were eyewitnesses; PW-16 spoke to motive and was told of the incident afterwards.

confession.reason: No confession or admission by the accused is mentioned.

aggravating_circumstances.reason: Sword use, gruesome assault and fatal injuries are noted by the court.

mitigating_circumstances.reason: Limited role, no intent or pre-concert, no motive and prolonged custody are noted for appellant No.2.

trial_court_outcome.reason: Life imprisonment and fines under s.302/34; one year SI and fine under s.506/34 match the judgment.

high_court_outcome.reason: High Court affirmed s.302/34 conviction and set aside s.506/34, as stated.

final_outcome.quote: we dismiss this appeal insofar as appellant-Manoj is concerned and uphold his conviction under Section 302 IPC
final_outcome.reason: Main accused Manoj was convicted and upheld; only appellant No.2's conviction was modified, so 'conviction_modified' misstates the main accused's result.

offence_finally_established.reason: Murder under s.302 for appellant No.1 and grievous hurt under s.325 for appellant No.2 match the judgment.

imprisonment_type.reason: Life imprisonment sentence for appellant No.1 was upheld.

imprisonment_years.reason: Final sentence for the main accused is life, so null is appropriate.

fine_rs.reason: Fine of Rs.10,000 under s.302/34 was upheld by the trial court and remained.

neutral_facts.correct_value: Same summary but refer to 'the accused' rather than 'the man' or 'the man's father', e.g. 'one of the accused was the father of the other accused'
neutral_facts.quote: two accused, one of whom was the man's father
neutral_facts.reason: Summary uses 'the man' instead of 'the accused' as instructed; otherwise accurate and does not reveal outcome.

offence_severity.reason: The judgment does not state the statutory maximum or minimum punishment for s.302.

attempt_completion.reason: The victim died, so the offence was completed.

physical_harm.reason: Death and listed ante-mortem injuries match the post-mortem report quoted.

number_of_offences.reason: Two sections charged; s.302 upheld for appellant No.1, s.325 substituted for appellant No.2.

financial_property_loss.reason: No money or property loss is discussed.

premeditation_planning.reason: Court noted no pre-concert to kill between the accused.

motive.reason: Court accepted suspicion of illicit intimacy and noted no motive alleged against appellant No.2.

key_evidence_accepted.reason: Eyewitness, prior threat, medical, FSL and site plan/seizure evidence are all relied on by the court.

witness_credibility.reason: Court found PWs 8, 18 and 16 reliable and noted hostile witnesses gave no support.

post_offence_conduct.reason: Flight is stated in PW-18's testimony and the value notes the court did not separately find it.

custody_duration.reason: Judgment states appellant No.2 was in jail nearly 3½ years; nothing on appellant No.1.

bail_history.reason: Bail history is not discussed in the judgment.

trial_duration.reason: Offence date, High Court and Supreme Court dates match; trial judgment date not given.

legal_representation.reason: H. Chandra Sekhar for appellants; C.B. Gururaj and V.N. Raghupathy for respondent.

investigation_status.reason: Case registered, charge-sheet filed and trial with 22 witnesses are stated.

procedural_irregularity.reason: No procedural lapse is noted by the court.

appeal_history.reason: Outcomes at trial, High Court and Supreme Court match the judgment.

prosecution_argument.reason: The judgment records no separate prosecution submissions in the Supreme Court.

defence_argument.reason: Stone-throwing role, no intent to kill and no pre-concert arguments are recorded.

legal_principle_applied.reason: Intention or shared intention needed for s.302; liability limited to own role; reliability assessed.

precedent_relied_upon.reason: No precedent or case citation is relied on in the judgment.

sentencing_rationale.reason: Court held time served 'should suffice' for appellant No.2, matching the value.

judicial_mitigating_factors.reason: Stone as trigger, no intent to kill, initial altercation and time served are weighed by the court.

judicial_aggravating_factors.reason: Court notes dangerous sword use to fatally injure the deceased in a gruesome assault.

other_sentence_order.reason: Release order for appellant No.2 and unaltered fine are directed.
